plugin.note: Use Blisterwood flail in Darkmeyer with Protect from Melee. Efaritay's aid improves accuracy and stacks with Slayer helmet, while the nearby bank and altar support long low-effort trips.

requirements: Completion of Sins of the Father for Darkmeyer access.
Blisterwood flail or another valid Vyrewatch weapon.
Drakan's medallion recommended for fast Darkmeyer or Ver Sinhaza travel.
mechanics: Vyrewatch Sentinels use melee slash attacks and are aggressive unless the player wears Vyre noble robes.
They are not undead, so Salve amulet has no effect.
Efaritay's aid provides a 15% accuracy bonus that stacks with Slayer helmet.
Vyrewatch can only be damaged by valid vyre weapons such as Ivandis flail, Blisterwood flail, Hallowed flail, or blisterwood stakes.
Saradomin godsword special attack can still heal health and prayer based on the calculated roll even though it deals zero damage.
After The Blood Moon Rises, Sentinels stop being aggressive unless aggression is re-enabled with a garlic cocktail.

methods.label: Darkmeyer transport
methods.summary: Use Drakan's medallion to reach Darkmeyer directly or travel through Ver Sinhaza and Meiyerditch into Darkmeyer.
steps: Teleport to Darkmeyer with Drakan's medallion and run north to the Sentinel area.
Alternatively teleport to Ver Sinhaza and use the Vyrewatch route to reach the Meiyerditch mine.
From the north of Meiyerditch, use the wall crack to enter Darkmeyer.
Bring Vyre noble clothing if using bank tellers.

methods.label: DPS setup
methods.summary: Use Blisterwood flail with melee strength gear, Slayer helmet on task, and Efaritay's aid for the accuracy bonus.
requiredOrKeyItems: Slayer helmet or black mask on task
prayers: Piety when prayer supply supports it
steps: Equip Blisterwood flail as the main weapon.
Use Slayer helmet on task because Efaritay's aid stacks with the Slayer helmet bonus.
Use melee strength gear when not prioritising prayer bonus.
Drink combat potions and maintain Protect from Melee.
notes: Efaritay's aid provides better DPS than standard melee rings but must be replaced after its charges are spent.

methods.label: Prayer AFK bank and altar
methods.summary: Fight near Darkmeyer's bank and altar, using Protect from Melee and refreshing prayer at the nearby statue instead of spending prayer potions.
recommendedFor: players collecting vampyre dust and blood shards
prayers: Piety or offensive melee prayers if desired
steps: Teleport to Darkmeyer and run north to the bank and altar area.
Activate Protect from Melee before engaging Sentinels.
Fight near the bank and altar so prayer can be restored without prayer potions.
Equip Vyre noble clothing before using Darkmeyer bank tellers, or use the Hallowed Sepulchre lobby bank chest.
Stand at least one tile away from the lamps so Vyrewatch do not get stuck.
notes: Collect vampyre dust if using it for Hallowed Sepulchre or prayer supplies.
A Ring of wealth can be used because Sentinels regularly drop coins.

methods.label: Aggression management
methods.summary: Keep Sentinels aggressive by avoiding Vyre noble clothing during combat, or use a garlic cocktail after The Blood Moon Rises.
requiredOrKeyItems: Garlic cocktail after The Blood Moon Rises
steps: Avoid wearing full Vyre noble clothing while fighting if you want normal aggression.
After The Blood Moon Rises, carry a garlic cocktail to re-enable Sentinel aggression.
Swap into Vyre noble clothing only for banking if using Darkmeyer bank tellers.

styleOptions.label: DPS melee
styleOptions.summary: Blisterwood flail, Slayer helmet on task, melee strength gear, and Efaritay's aid for accuracy.

styleOptions.label: Prayer AFK
styleOptions.summary: Prayer-bonus melee gear near the Darkmeyer bank and altar with Protect from Melee active.
